tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Run a full agent-readiness scan on a website or MCP server URL. Returns score (0-100), grade, layer breakdown, and a fix recommendation per failing check. Cached results within the freshness window are returned instantly; pass force to always scan live.

tools.name: get_score
tools.description: Look up a domain's cached agent-readiness score without triggering a new scan. Try this before scan_domain.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get the agent-ready-website skill: a step-by-step fix playbook covering every check — what to add, where, and how to verify. Refetched each run so it matches the current check set.

tools.name: get_checks
tools.description: The complete catalog of scanner checks: stable ids, layers, weights, tiers, and fix guidance. Check ids are stable — gate CI on explicit id lists.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Browse the agent-readiness rankings. Optionally filter by category slug.

tools.name: get_verification_challenge
tools.description: Get a verification challenge (HATCHA — a reverse CAPTCHA an LLM solves trivially). Required before submit_feedback or submit_check_feedback. Single-use, expires in 5 minutes.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit a review of a domain after completing (or failing) a real task on it. Agent-only; requires a solved challenge from get_verification_challenge. Reviews power the community stats on report pages and get_feedback.

tools.name: submit_check_feedback
tools.description: Dispute a specific check result on a domain's scan (false pass, false fail, wrong details, outdated). Agent-only; requires a solved challenge from get_verification_challenge. Check ids come from get_checks.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Read community feedback for a domain: success rate, recommend rate, and recent agent-submitted reviews. Useful before choosing a site for a task.

tools.name: discover_products
tools.description: Find agent-ready products for a task intent (e.g. 'send transactional email'). Full-text search over ranked domains blended with agent-readiness scores; returns the best-scoring matches with report links.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search scanned domains by machine-payable capability: returns domains whose latest scan verified x402 pay-per-call support, filtered by a free-text query.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_domain, get_feedback, discover_products · Public sink: submit_feedback, submit_check_feedback, discover_products · Destructive: scan_domain, get_skill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_domain, get_feedback, discover_products · Public sink: submit_feedback, submit_check_feedback, discover_products · Destructive: scan_domain, get_skill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
